title: Architectural Services for Engine Company 23 Arts Center Phase II
short_description: Rehabilitation of a historic fire station into a junior arts center in Los Angeles.
project_scope: Interior and exterior rehabilitation of an existing historic fire station for conversion into a Junior Arts Center. Scope includes architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, historic preservation documentation, bid support, and construction administration services. The project is a refurbishment of an existing building; no gross floor area is stated.
services: Architectural services; structural engineering; civil engineering; mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering; historic preservation; interior design/space planning; programming; rehabilitation and refurbishment; bid support; construction administration; construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing building rehabilitation, not a new structurally ambitious project.
- Building type is a small arts center conversion, not a major cultural landmark or long-span structure.
- Structural engineering is included, but as one discipline among many.
- Total construction cost is modest, limiting strategic relevance for sbp.
- Historic preservation and multidisciplinary building rehabilitation are outside sbp's core focus compared with bridges and special structures.

fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the tender documents.

Specific minimum reference requirements are not stated in the provided text.
